title: README documents obsolete external-mode uncertain handling
reasoning: The README says external unattended mode retains uncertain findings in the same-finding repair loop, while the authoritative project contract permits committing an uncertain repair, advancing to the next open finding, and honestly reporting the retained uncertainty. Only strict library mode retains the stop behavior.
recommendation: Update the README to distinguish external unattended behavior from strict library behavior, including completion-proof and exit-status semantics.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are linked to this feature, and behavioral tests would not detect stale documentation.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a documentation contract check requiring distinct descriptions of external and strict-library uncertain handling.
